title: osfeed: open-source Linux tools by what they can do
excerpt: A field guide to open-source tools, starting with Omarchy: what each tool can do today, what it needs, where it falls short, and what changed.
content_html:
A field guide to open-source tools, starting with Omarchy

What do you want
your Linux to do?

Ask in your own words, here or from your AI agent.
See what tools really do today, sourced from their code and releases, and hear when that changes.

117 projects1689 things you can do688 changes that need action, with what to do

Open source MCP servers for AWSMCP servers for working with AWS services Use an MCP client to look up AWS documentation, manage cloud resources, query databases, and investigate costs and application be… Added 10 Oct 20269.8k Apify MCP ServerAn MCP server for Apify scraping and automation tools Find and run Apify Actors from an MCP client, retrieve their data, and manage tasks, schedules, builds, and Actor source files. Added 10 Oct 202610.3k IDA Pro MCPAn MCP server for reverse engineering with IDA Pro Analyze binaries, annotate disassembly, and control IDA Pro from an MCP client. Added 10 Oct 202612.6k PlydeskA desktop for remote Linux machines over SSH Manage files, services and packages on remote Linux machines, run terminal sessions, and open VS Code from your Mac. Added 10 Oct 2026 MCP for UnityAn MCP bridge for the Unity Editor Control Unity scenes, edit scripts and assets, run tests, and build games from an MCP client. Added 10 Oct 202614.8k Framelink MCP for FigmaAn MCP server and CLI for Figma design context Give coding tools Figma layouts, styles, text, and image assets to help implement designs. Added 10 Oct 202616k
